notes: Reference SQL targets the bi views. accept_sql lists other legitimate readings of an ambiguous question. Golden questions must NOT duplicate data/bi_examples.json (a test enforces it).

questions.question: How many confirmed orders do we have in total?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed'

questions.question: What is the total revenue from all confirmed orders?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_total), 0) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed'

questions.question: How many products are on the menu?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM products

questions.question: What is the price of the Latte?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT price FROM products WHERE product_name = 'Latte'
accept_sql: SELECT price FROM products WHERE product_name ILIKE '%latte%'

questions.question: How many customers have placed at least one order?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE orders_count > 0

questions.question: How many carts are currently pending?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_carts FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending'

questions.question: How many products cost more than 400 rupees?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM products WHERE price > 400

questions.question: How many orders were placed today?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_today FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND order_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date

questions.question: What was the revenue yesterday?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_total), 0) AS revenue_yesterday FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND order_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1

questions.question: How many different products have been sold so far?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS products_sold FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed'

questions.question: How many units have we sold in total?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS units_sold FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed'

questions.question: What is our total customer count?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers

questions.question: What is the average order value overall?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) AS average_order_value FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed'

questions.question: How many products are in the Bakery category?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM products WHERE category = 'Bakery'

questions.question: Which 3 products earned the most revenue overall?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(line_total) AS revenue FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_name LIMIT 3

questions.question: Which product sold the most units in the last 30 days?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND order_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 30 GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, product_name LIMIT 1
accept_sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND order_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 29 GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, product_name LIMIT 1

questions.question: How much revenue did each category bring in?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, SUM(line_total) AS revenue FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY category

questions.question: What was the revenue for each of the last 7 days?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT days.d AS day, COALESCE(SUM(o.order_total), 0) AS revenue FROM (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - n AS d FROM generate_series(0, 6) AS n) days LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_date = days.d AND o.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY days.d ORDER BY days.d

questions.question: How many orders did each weekday get?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT order_weekday, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY order_weekday

questions.question: What was the revenue in each of the last 3 months?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT m.d AS month, COALESCE(SUM(o.order_total), 0) AS revenue FROM (SELECT (date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') - make_interval(months => n))::date AS d FROM generate_series(0, 2) AS n) m LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_month = m.d AND o.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY m.d ORDER BY m.d
accept_sql: SELECT m.d AS month, COALESCE(SUM(o.order_total), 0) AS revenue FROM (SELECT (date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') - make_interval(months => n))::date AS d FROM generate_series(1, 3) AS n) m LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_month = m.d AND o.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY m.d ORDER BY m.d

questions.question: Which customers have placed more than 5 orders?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT customer_id, orders_count FROM customers WHERE orders_count > 5

questions.question: How much did the Bakery category earn this month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line_total), 0) AS revenue FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND category = 'Bakery' AND order_month = date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date

questions.question: Which hour of the day has the most orders?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT order_hour, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY order_hour ORDER BY orders DESC, order_hour LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the average order value in each month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT order_month, ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) AS average_order_value FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY order_month

questions.question: How many units were sold in each category?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY category

questions.question: How many customers do we have in each location?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(location, 'Unknown') AS location, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY 1
accept_sql: SELECT location, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY location

questions.question: Which products have a rating above 4.5?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE rating > 4.5

questions.question: How much revenue came from orders worth more than 800 rupees?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_total), 0) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND order_total > 800

questions.question: Which day had the most orders?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT order_date, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY orders DESC, order_date LIMIT 1

questions.question: What percentage of total revenue comes from the Coffee category?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_total) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Coffee') * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(line_total), 0), 1) AS coffee_share_percent FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed'

questions.question: How much more or less did we earn this month than last month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(order_total) FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND order_month = date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(order_total) FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND order_month = (date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') - interval '1 month')::date), 0) AS revenue_difference

questions.question: Which customers have not ordered in the last 30 days but did order before?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE last_order_at IS NOT NULL AND (last_order_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 30
accept_sql: SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE last_order_at IS NOT NULL AND (last_order_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 30
SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE last_order_at IS NOT NULL AND last_order_at < now() - interval '30 days'

questions.question: How many customers ordered in more than one different month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_month) > 1) t

questions.question: What is the best selling product in each category by units?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, product_name, units_sold FROM (SELECT category, product_name, SUM(quantity) AS units_sold, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY SUM(quantity) DESC, product_name) AS rn FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY category, product_name) t WHERE rn = 1

questions.question: How many orders contained both a Coffee item and a Bakery item?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.status = 'confirmed' AND oi.category = 'Coffee' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items b WHERE b.order_id = oi.order_id AND b.category = 'Bakery')

questions.question: On average, how many days pass between a customer's first and last order? Only count customers with more than one order.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG((last_order_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - (first_order_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date), 1) AS avg_days_between_first_and_last_order FROM customers WHERE orders_count > 1

questions.question: Which categories earn more than 20% of total revenue?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category FROM (SELECT category, SUM(line_total) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(line_total)) OVER (), 0) AS pct FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY category) t WHERE pct > 20 ORDER BY category

questions.question: Who are our top 3 customers by total spend, with their number of orders?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT customer_id, total_spent, orders_count FROM customers WHERE orders_count > 0 ORDER BY total_spent DESC, customer_id LIMIT 3

questions.question: What percentage of our ordering customers are repeat customers?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE orders_count >= 2) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE orders_count >= 1), 0), 1) AS repeat_customer_percent FROM customers
accept_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE orders_count >= 2) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS repeat_customer_percent FROM customers

questions.question: How many orders came from customers who are allergic to nuts?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'confirmed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customers c, jsonb_array_elements_text(c.allergies) AS a WHERE c.customer_id = o.customer_id AND a ILIKE '%nut%')

questions.question: Show the cumulative revenue day by day for the last 5 days.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT d AS day, SUM(rev) OVER (ORDER BY d) AS cumulative_revenue FROM (SELECT days.d, COALESCE(SUM(o.order_total), 0) AS rev FROM (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - n AS d FROM generate_series(0, 4) AS n) days LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_date = days.d AND o.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY days.d) t ORDER BY d

questions.question: And by units sold instead?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, product_name LIMIT 3

questions.question: Only the Bakery category please.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, SUM(line_total) AS revenue FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND category = 'Bakery' GROUP BY category

questions.question: What about yesterday?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_yesterday FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND order_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1

questions.question: Now show revenue instead.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, SUM(line_total) AS revenue FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY category

questions.question: Make it the top 5.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT customer_id, total_spent, orders_count FROM customers WHERE orders_count > 0 ORDER BY total_spent DESC, customer_id LIMIT 5

questions.question: And which weekday has the most?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT order_weekday, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY order_weekday ORDER BY orders DESC, order_weekday LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show revenue by category as a pie chart
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, SUM(line_total) AS revenue FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY category

questions.question: Show the top 3 products by revenue as a bar chart
questions.reference_sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(line_total) AS revenue FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_name LIMIT 3

questions.question: Show revenue for each of the last 3 months as a line chart
questions.reference_sql: SELECT m.d AS month, COALESCE(SUM(o.order_total), 0) AS revenue FROM (SELECT (date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') - make_interval(months => n))::date AS d FROM generate_series(0, 2) AS n) m LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_month = m.d AND o.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY m.d ORDER BY m.d
accept_sql: SELECT m.d AS month, COALESCE(SUM(o.order_total), 0) AS revenue FROM (SELECT (date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') - make_interval(months => n))::date AS d FROM generate_series(1, 3) AS n) m LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_month = m.d AND o.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY m.d ORDER BY m.d

questions.question: Give me units sold per category in a table
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY category
